content.caption:
POV: you need your ID and can't find it. Here's a documents folder for emergency preparedness, done in 10 minutes.

Put copies in one waterproof pouch:
• ID and passports
• Insurance policies
• Important phone numbers, written on paper
• Medical info: allergies, medicine list, doctor's contact

Keep the originals somewhere safe. The pouch holds copies. Store it near the door, so it's ready if you leave or stay put.

Check it twice a year. Calm and simple.
